title.narrative: Resilience of the Libyan Transfusion System through Quality Management - Phase 2 of the MENDAMI Programme

description.narrative: This project will support the Libya¿s National Regulatory Authority for Blood Services (NRABS) through structuring its governance, promote management protocols and tools promoted internationally in transfusion medicine and therefore help building the resilience of the national blood transfusion system. The overall objective of this programme is to contribute to increase capacities of the Libyan National Blood Transfusion System to enable its resilience at local and national levels. Two specific objectives are defined: Specific objective 1: Ensure quality transfusion medicine services in blood establishments and hospitals through quality management; Specific objective 2: Ensure the availability of blood products in the blood establishments targeted.
